interface.signature: canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: The length of s is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The length of t is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The number of moves k is at least 0 and at most 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in s are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in t are lowercase English letters.
The lengths of s and t are equal.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum(min(ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i]), 26 - (ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i]))) for i in range(len(s))) <= k)
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the number of moves required to convert s into t is no more than k.
